text:
My pick for the best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power bank for iPhone 17 is the Baseus PicoGo AM52 if you want a balance of fast wireless charging, useful capacity, and price. If slimness above all else is your priority, the Anker Nano is the better-documented choice.

The pasted results don't establish a single winner on both thickness and charging speed, so here's how I'd choose.

Best picks at a glance
Best overall

Baseus PicoGo AM52 Qi2.2 10,000mAh

$53.99

With code AM52; listed price $59.99

Qi2.2 wireless charging up to 25W on iPhone 17 with iOS 26.

10,000mAh capacity and 45W wired output.

Thickness and weight aren't provided, so slimness is unverified.

Buy from Baseus via Dealectric

Source: Dealectric

Best for a slim profile

Anker Nano Power Bank 5K MagGo Slim

$54.99

Just 8.6 mm thick and 122 g (4.3 oz).

5,000mAh capacity and 15W Qi2 wireless charging.

Ideal for a lightweight daily carry, but offers half the capacity of the Baseus.

Buy from Anker US

Source: Anker official store

Best thin 10K alternative

INIU SnapGo Air 10K

$54.99

10,000mAh capacity and up to 25W wireless charging.

Listed at 0.5 inches thick and 195.4 g.

Digital display and built-in cable.

[Find the INIU SnapGo Air](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-in iu-reelcharge)

Source: [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-in iu-reelcharge)

My recommendation: Get the Anker Nano if you want the least bulk attached to your iPhone. Choose the Baseus PicoGo AM52 if you prefer twice the battery capacity and faster wireless charging for essentially the same price.

One caveat: the supplied results don't give a verified thickness for the Baseus AM52, and the INIU listing is from a review rather than a confirmed live retailer listing. The Anker link goes directly to the manufacturer's store.
